request.system: You are an API endpoint. Every response is a single JSON object and nothing else.

messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
Name: [Patient Name]
Medical Record Number: [MRN]

Admission Date: [Admission Date]
Discharge Date: [Discharge Date]

History of Present Illness:
The patient, a 53-year-old male with a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus and dyslipidemia, underwent laparoscopic right hemicolectomy with D3 lymphadenectomy for moderately differentiated tubular adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon. Postoperative surveillance revealed a 23-mm sessile polyp at the superior rectum, which was successfully removed by endoscopic mucosal resection. 39 months after EMR, a mass lesion was found in the presacral area on CT as postoperative surveillance. The patient underwent LAR with D3 lymphadenectomy, and the recurrent site was completely removed without adjuvant chemotherapy.

Hospital Course:

Admission:
The patient was admitted for LAR with D3 lymphadenectomy due to presacral lymph node recurrence of rectal cancer.

Treatment:
The patient underwent LAR with D3 lymphadenectomy, and the recurrent site was completely removed by surgery.

Clinical Progress:
The postoperative course was uneventful, and he was discharged from our hospital on postoperative day 11.

Discharge Condition:
The patient was discharged in a stable condition.
Discharge Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Disposition:
The patient was discharged home in stable condition.

Instructions:
The patient should follow up with his primary care physician and oncologist for postoperative surveillance per their recommendations.

Signed,
[Physician Name]
[Title]

Respond with the JSON object only, starting with { and ending with }.

text:
The admission was for presacral lymph node recurrence of rectal cancer. The rectal polyp was removed by EMR and the recurrence was in the presacral lymph nodes, so this is a secondary malignancy of the lymph nodes, which would be C77 (secondary and unspecified malignant neoplasm of lymph nodes). The other option is C20 (malignant neoplasm of rectum). The record calls it "presacral lymph node recurrence of rectal cancer", and the reason for admission was surgery on that recurrence. Pelvic lymph node metastasis codes to C77.5 (intrapelvic lymph nodes), so the principal diagnosis is C77.

{"code": "C77", "condition": "Secondary malignant neoplasm of lymph nodes (presacral nodal recurrence of rectal cancer)"}
